name: grokbuildorderproject
top_fix: Delete the three empty dirs backend/src/{controllers,middleware,types} and add a 'what the database sees' race timeline table to astraupskill/02-CONCEPTS.md.
summary: Real Express/Prisma/PostgreSQL + React app where the delivered change is inventory reservation done properly: one interactive transaction, conditional updateMany guarded by a version column and a stock floor, Decimal money, purchase-time name/price snapshots, FK-protected deletes. 37 tests on disk (24 backend + 8 component + 5 Chromium) match the claim exactly and are named after invariants. VERIFICATION.md records its own failed runs and refuses to count them. Densest-per-word course in the batch.

name: grokbuildppmproject
top_fix: Fix astraupskill/README.md: taskController.ts is byte-identical to its before-snapshot and was never repaired; say instead that the controller was deliberately left alone because the trust boundary moved into the service.
summary: A sharp two-to-three hour drill on one high-value bug: a PATCH route that Zod-parsed the body and threw the parsed value away, letting raw req.body reach prisma.task.update. The repair moves strict schemas into the service so every caller crosses the boundary, distinguishes Prisma P2025 from a real outage, and adds async error forwarding. Seven byte-exact before-snapshots ship with the course and the 14 tests (8 backend + 6 frontend) match the raw vitest logs. Narrow: Prisma is mocked, so nothing proves persistence, FKs or tenant isolation, and exercises 2-6 are pre-answered by the delivered source.

name: grokbuildteamproject
top_fix: Name projectRepository.ts explicitly in 03-WORKED-CHANGE.md and flag taskRepository.ts/taskService.ts as 9-line re-export shims, then add prerequisites and pacing to astraupskill/README.md.
summary: The best multi-tenant CRUD course in the set. Starts from a scaffold whose task routes had no auth and whose tests asserted expect([201,400,401]).toContain(res.status), and ends with authority derived from a per-request PostgreSQL membership lookup rather than the token, every query scoped by (id, organizationId), compound foreign keys so the database itself rejects a cross-team assignee, and every mutation a version-guarded updateMany plus an audit row in one transaction. 83 checks on disk in exactly the claimed proportions. Dense; plan two passes.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/e14
top_fix: Add astraupskill/08-TRANSLATION.md mapping scoped_record/extra=forbid/version_id_col/If-Match to Prisma+Zod and EF Core equivalents; without it the project cannot justify a slot in a JS/.NET path.
summary: Technically the most thorough delivery in the batch: real tenant scoping that 404s on a cross-org ID, ETag/If-Match revisions backed by SQLAlchemy version_id_col, strict contracts rejecting unknown fields, deduplication placed before transformation inside the ingestion transaction, a bounded read-only SQL path and a durable outbox whose verification admits no real webhook was ever sent. But it is FastAPI/Pydantic/SQLAlchemy and the nine documents never name a single JS or .NET equivalent. Read 02-CONCEPTS and 03-WORKED-CHANGE as an essay on CRUD invariants; do not spend an evening on the Python tooling.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/e15
top_fix: Add astraupskill/08-TRANSLATION.md mapping check_expected_version (428/422/409) and the Versioned mixin to Express/ASP.NET If-Match handling, EF Core [Timestamp] and Prisma conditional updateMany.
summary: A help desk with the most precise concurrency contract in the batch: every mutating route demands If-Match and answers 428 when absent, 422 when malformed, 409 when the version moved, while a SQLAlchemy Versioned mixin adds a second independent predicate at the ORM layer, and the course argues why you want both. The conflict UI keeps the losing draft, shows the stored record beside it, and explicitly refuses to auto-merge. Verification lists the bugs its own screenshot review found. Off-stack backend with no bridge to JS/.NET; the vanilla-JS frontend half (draft retention, stale-search sequence invalidation) is directly reusable.

name: aiapplybot
top_fix: Move virtualenv + requirements-dev + Playwright install into astraupskill/README.md before its first command; today chapter 1 fails on a clean machine because setup lives only in VERIFICATION.md (chapter 9).
summary: Astra took a job-application bot with almost no CRUD value and grafted a genuine SQLite application tracker onto it. ApplicationStore.update validates outside the write transaction, compares the captured version, runs UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND version=?, insists rowcount==1, writes the audit event in the same transaction and re-reads. The browser half captures a baseline before the request, keeps the draft on 409, and keeps 'saved' and 'list refresh failed' as two separate outcomes. 43 Python + 8 Chromium checks match exactly and profile.yaml was provably never opened. Stdlib http.server with hand-rolled routing, so nothing about frameworks, ORMs or migrations transfers.

name: JSProjectLearn
top_fix: Add npx playwright install chromium to astraupskill/README.md's setup block and date-stamp VERIFICATION.md's counts, because the tree has drifted (drafts.test.ts, Dashboard/LessonReader/MissionScreen and 4 extra Playwright tests are all dated 2026-09-11, two days after delivery).
summary: The only project in the batch already on the target stack (React 19 / TS / Vite / Vitest / Playwright), and it teaches the client half of CRUD properly: notes with stable identities, search, pagination and confirmed deletion over pure immutable domain functions, a schema that is the authoritative boundary ('imported JSON bypasses maxLength'), a revision check that throws before setItem so a rejected save writes nothing, a losing tab that keeps and can export its draft, and corrupt stored bytes preserved rather than clobbered. 36 model cases reconcile exactly once the two it.each blocks are expanded; the browser count was under-claimed. No HTTP, SQL, authz or migrations.

name: _Organized Desktop/02 Build Projects/buildgum
top_fix: Add a three-outcome timeline (write rejected / write + response delivered / write succeeded + acknowledgement lost) to 03-WORKED-CHANGE.md Step 4, plus a 'what this becomes on a server' paragraph mapping requestKey to an Idempotency-Key row and the raw-baseline check to If-Match.
summary: The best money-and-idempotency lesson in the batch. A checkout that flipped a boolean and printed a fixed order number was replaced by integer-cent arithmetic you can verify by hand (the course's floor((7800*20+50)/100)=1560 is the literal expression in src/model.ts against the seeded 3900-cent product and BUILD20), receipts that snapshot title and price at checkout, cart lines sorted by id so equivalent carts share a fingerprint, and a request-key replay inside the storage lock so a retry after a lost acknowledgement returns the existing receipt. 44 unit (37 literal + 7 loop-generated) and 15 Chromium checks match; setup is exactly pinned with a fixed 127.0.0.1:5180 origin and an explanation of why the origin matters. Browser-only: no server, database or authorization.
